bio: Please note from 28th June - 28th July only the Wimbledon Afternoon Tea will be served. Please click here for more information.  The Terrace Restaurant houses a conservatory-style seating area with floor-to-ceiling windows and a vibrant cocktail bar, located within the Blakemore Hyde Park Hotel, just a 5 minute walk from Bayswater and Queensway Underground stations.  Indulge in a Traditional Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco or Champagne, featuring elegant finger sandwiches, warm classic scones served with clotted cream and jam, followed by a selection of cakes and desserts.  Alternatively, step into a regal realm with their Kings Guard Afternoon Tea (£34.95pp), featuring savoury delights and royal pastries fit for Kings and Queens.  Choose from a range of fine teas including English Breakfast, Earl Grey, Peppermint, and Fruit Teas.  Afternoon Teas are freshly made onsite and beautifully presented in a 3-tier bird cage style tea stand. Each tier is delicately hand plated and presented in the traditional 3 sections.
